name: 08525 · Hopewell, NJ
findings: ZIP 08525 (Hopewell) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08525 (Hopewell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08525 (Hopewell) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
